capabilities: Share a note or a whole folder subtree over the local network
Serve read-only browser previews with Markdown, wikilinks, images, callouts and Mermaid
Browse shared content in a three-pane layout with sidebar tree and outline
Protect links with a random access token that can be reset
Start and stop the server from the settings tab
disambiguation: Not a file-transfer or sync tool; it only serves read-only browser previews of the notes and folders you explicitly share.
extras: Server does not auto-start with the plugin unless enabled; binds to 0.0.0.0 by default and can be restricted to 127.0.0.1. README also contains a Chinese section and steps for submitting the plugin to the community directory.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to let someone else on the same network read a note without installing Obsidian or putting it on the public internet.

relations.evidence: 飞书式分享开关：笔记右上角按钮一键分享/取消

summary: Serves shared notes and folders over the local network so anyone on it can open a read-only browser preview with wikilinks, images and Mermaid.
